content.text: {"story":{"as_a":"registered user of the task list","i_want":"to update an existing task's title, description, priority and Due Date","so_that":"my task details stay accurate","business_description":"Users can edit an existing task through the same form used to create tasks. The form covers Title, Description, Priority and Due Date and applies the same validation as create. The backend confirms each update before the frontend shows it as saved.","business_value":"Tasks can be corrected after creation without deleting and recreating them, so the task list stays accurate.","acceptance_criteria":[{"given":"an existing task with a valid title and a Due Date not earlier than its Creation Date","when":"the user opens the edit form, changes the title, and submits the form","then":"the backend stores the new title, and after the backend returns success the task list is reloaded from the backend and shows the new title"},{"given":"an existing task being edited in the form","when":"the user clears the title field and submits the form","then":"the backend rejects the update, the task keeps its previous title, and an error message stating that the title is mandatory is shown"},{"given":"an existing task with Creation Date 2024-05-10","when":"the user sets the Due Date to 2024-05-09 and submits the update","then":"the backend rejects the update with a validation error, the stored Due Date is unchanged, and an error message is shown"},{"given":"an existing task with a title of 100 characters","when":"the user changes the title to 101 characters and submits the update","then":"the backend rejects the update with a validation error, the stored title is unchanged, and an error message stating that the title must be 100 characters or fewer is shown"},{"given":"an existing task being edited in the form","when":"the user changes the description or priority and submits the form with valid values","then":"the backend stores the new description or priority, and after the backend returns success the task list is reloaded from the backend and shows the new values"},{"given":"an existing task whose update request succeeds","when":"the backend saves the update","then":"the backend sets the task's Last Updated Date to the time of the update"},{"given":"a task update request where the backend returns an error","when":"the frontend receives the error response","then":"the frontend does not show the task as updated and displays an error message"},{"given":"a task update request where the backend returns success","when":"the frontend receives the success response","then":"the frontend displays a success message after the update action and reloads the task list from the backend"},{"given":"a task ID that does not exist in the database","when":"an update request is sent for that ID","then":"the backend returns a Task Not Found error, no data is changed, and the frontend shows a Task Not Found error message"},{"given":"the database is unavailable during an update","when":"the update is submitted","then":"the backend returns an internal/database error, the stored task is unchanged, and the frontend shows an error message and does not show the task as updated"},{"given":"an update request has been sent and the backend has not yet responded","when":"the edit form is waiting for the response","then":"the task list still shows the previous values and no success message is shown"}],"edge_cases":["The user submits the same values as the stored task: the request is handled as a normal update and the outcome is shown
